title.zh: 将马尼拉大都会马拉邦市镇胡隆杜哈特描笼涯马拉邦市镇中学的名称变更为马拉邦国立中学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Malabon Municipal High School Situated in Barangay Hulong-duhat, Municipality of Malabon, Metro Manila, to Malabon National High School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Malabon Municipal High School Situated in Barangay Hulong-duhat, Municipality of Malabon, Metro Manila, to Malabon National High School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1994/ra_7709_1994.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Malabon Municipal High School situated in Barangay Hulong-Duhat, Municipality of Malabon, Metro Manila, is hereby changed to Malabon National High School.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
